say:1:1230228001:0.text: Both the southern and northern parts of Blackwood Loch are guarded by the Carmine Whispers. Obviously, we sneaked our way in!
say:1:1230228001:0.source_cn: 黑木湖南北都有血薇帮值守，当然是偷溜过来的！
say:1:1230228001:0.male: Both the southern and northern parts of Blackwood Loch are guarded by the Carmine Whispers. Obviously, we sneaked our way in!
say:1:1230228001:0.female: Both the southern and northern parts of Blackwood Loch are guarded by the Carmine Whispers. Obviously, we sneaked our way in!

say:2:1230228002:0.text: The Blackwood Loch boasts a wide variety of fish. Who gives them the right to ban fishing here? It's not like they own the lake!
say:2:1230228002:0.source_cn: 黑木湖里能钓到很多品种的鱼，湖又不是血薇帮挖的，凭什么...
say:2:1230228002:0.male: The Blackwood Loch boasts a wide variety of fish. Who gives them the right to ban fishing here? It's not like they own the lake!
say:2:1230228002:0.female: The Blackwood Loch boasts a wide variety of fish. Who gives them the right to ban fishing here? It's not like they own the lake!

say:3:1230228003:0.text: We are as tough as nails! No one can stop us from fishing!
say:3:1230228003:0.source_cn: 钓鱼人都有愈挫愈勇的心，谁也别想阻止我们钓鱼！
say:3:1230228003:0.male: We are as tough as nails! No one can stop us from fishing!
say:3:1230228003:0.female: We are as tough as nails! No one can stop us from fishing!

say:4:1230228004:0.text: Even if we do bump into the Carmine Whispers... I won't get caught as long as I run faster than Cohen!
say:4:1230228004:0.source_cn: 就算遇见血薇帮的巡查人员……我只需要跑的比科恩快就好了！
say:4:1230228004:0.male: Even if we do bump into the Carmine Whispers... I won't get caught as long as I run faster than Cohen!
say:4:1230228004:0.female: Even if we do bump into the Carmine Whispers... I won't get caught as long as I run faster than Cohen!
